messages:
jordan_partnerships: Quick heads-up  Zenith Payments signed a co-sell agreement and we went live on AWS Marketplace today. They also agreed to a joint webinar and a short case study.

lina_marketing: Nice!! Do we have the marketplace listing link? Need it for the blog and tweet.

jordan_partnerships: Link is here: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/zenith-payments-redwood. Marketing can use the logo + approved quote (legal cleared).

omar_sales: Huge win for mid-market payments. Any early numbers from their pilot?

kevin_eng: From the onboarding run: 35% fewer GPU-hours after we activated per-route caching profiles and switched to 4-bit quantized variants for their nightly batch scoring. P95 tail went from ~480ms to ~220ms on their live traffic mix.

sue_pm: For the webinar, Zenith suggested a 30-minute tech+customer panel. Proposed date: May 14 PT. They want a short demo of request routing and dedicated fallback. Lina, can you lead the invite?

lina_marketing: I can. Will draft the landing page and a social pack. Need a 1-paragraph tech blurb and 2 screenshots (latency graph + routing UI). Kevin, can you provide the blurb and screenshots by EOD Friday?

kevin_eng: Yes. I'll export the dashboard and write two sentences on routing + autoscale behavior.

omar_sales: Also adding a sales enablement one-pager would help - callouts on contract terms and onboarding SLA. Can we get a short list of recommended talking points?

jordan_partnerships: I'll add talking points to the task. Key ones: reserved capacity, burst policy, and single-tenant data isolation.

deploy-bot: task created: "Zenith AWS marketplace + webinar"  assignees: lina_marketing, kevin_eng, jordan_partnerships. Due: 2026-05-10. Link: https://redwood/ops/tasks/4121

lina_marketing: Quick check: does Zenith want the case study public or gated? They asked for gated (lead capture) but ok with a short public blog snippet. I'll follow up on the CTA.

sue_pm: Let's make the public blurb minimal and push the full case study behind gate. Keeps pipeline clean.

omar_sales: Agreed. Also flagging: Zenith asked about a co-branded datasheet for AWS Marketplace listing — design team will need the logo and color guidance. Jordan, do we have brand assets?

jordan_partnerships: Uploaded to the task. Also uploaded the signed co-sell addendum.

lina_marketing: Plan: blog + webinar landing page + tweet + sales one-pager + gated case study. Ill post drafts in #marketing-review tomorrow.

kevin_eng: For the engineering appendix: I'll include kernel/quantization notes and the small-batch warmup script snippet. Two small code blocks and a short config diff.

jordan_partnerships: Heads-up for leadership: this is a good reference for our marketplace motion. We'll mention this in next week's all-hands and put a slide in the partner update.

lina_marketing: Added to comms calendar for the all-hands.

omar_sales: Congrats everyone  big momentum for Q2 bookings.

kevin_eng: :thumbsup:
